d:
Bihar ke mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki chhoti beti shivangi sinh ki shadi ki charcha pure bihar aur desh men shuru ho chuki hai. shivangi ka sasural bihta men hai, jahan ghar ki pahli bahu ke svagat men unke sasur kamandent ranvijay sinh naya ghar bana rahe hain. usi ghar men shadi ki taiyari chal rahi hai. shadi kaise tay huee, vistar se parhen.
